description: Extend POST /api/teams/{id}/ask. (1) Draft intent: when the question asks to draft/recommend/suggest/fill/complete the team, include recommend.recommend_additions candidates as grounded chunks AND emit a new SSE `candidates` event with the structured list so the UI can render Add cards. (2) Add-by-name action: detect an imperative add/include with a resolvable species name in the message (distinguish from 'which should I add' recommendations — those have no concrete name), add that species to the next empty slot via teams service, then emit a `team_updated` event (with the refreshed team) plus a short confirmation. Team full / unresolved name → a graceful message, no crash. Keep the existing grounded/cited/abstain behavior for normal questions.
title: Coach endpoint: surface candidates + add-by-name action
